resources.string: Choose what you want to discover. Regional observances do not change Iranian public holidays. The same choice applies to notifications and the widget.
All packs are hidden. Your tasks and favorites are kept.

Editable stages, working-day suggestions, and duplicate protection
Review titles, dates and selected stages. Only confirmed stages are saved together. Past stages are excluded until you choose a future date. Undo on Home removes the whole plan.
Move preparation before Iranian weekends and registered holidays
Suggested earlier to avoid a non-working day. The occasion itself does not move.
